ref: spec #70 story 5: inv is an assumed reading, 1 divided by the value; obs-arithmetic i1.xml decides
note: inv is read as 1 divided by the value, with ADR-0005's division rule: 1/4 is 0.25, 1/3 is 0.333333333333333333, 1/-2 is -0.5 and 1/0.5 is 2. To observe in PO: the other reading of inv is the sign change.
